# Test fixtures

Real Dragon Quest VII (3DS) saves, used as read-only test inputs. Only `save000.bin` to `save003.bin` are kept; `system.bin` and `cardinfo.bin` are left out because they hold console identifiers.

Credits:

- `us_superkiefer`, `us_postgame`: saves by DaniPhoFani (archive.org, "dqvii-3-ds-save-files").
- `pal_superkiefer`, `pal_postgame`: saves by Gronya (woodus.com, "DRAGON QUEST 7 PRESERVED").

They were preserved for the community after the 2024-04-08 shutdown of the tablet servers.

## Tablets in each file

Listed newest first, as stored in the save.

Woebegone Cave; Demon's Dome; Treasure Hunt; Feline Forest; Sticky Business; Slimetree Forest
